# @univerjs-pro/slides-thread-comment-ui

`@univerjs-pro/slides-thread-comment-ui` adds free-position and element comment entries to Univer Slides. Drafts open in the shared thread comment panel.

## Installation

```sh
pnpm add @univerjs-pro/slides-thread-comment-ui
```

Import the package CSS and register `UniverSlidesThreadCommentUIPlugin` after the Slides UI plugin.
